metrics.field_correctness: correct fields / gold fields expected (required + optional present/absent)
metrics.unsupported_fill: filled fields not supported by gold / filled fields
metrics.abstention: correctly absent or null fields / gold absent-or-null fields
metrics.evidence_recall: gold evidence pages retrieved / annotated evidence pages
metrics.reference_validity: valid cited pages / all cited pages

quality_gate.per_stratum: page_routed field correctness must not decrease vs full_document; unsupported fills must not increase

decision: Missing approved rollout thresholds or provider evidence is NO_GO for expansion; this rubric does not invent speed/cost thresholds.
evidence_rules: A cited page must belong to the bound parse_result_id and contain a non-empty citation. Alternative pages must be listed in gold; semantically related pages alone do not count.
